title: Mobile Developer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Mobile Developer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. Platform Fundamentals: Activity/Fragment lifecycle (Android) or UIViewController lifecycle (iOS), or cross-platform equivalents in React Native/Flutter.
2. UI & Performance: Layout rendering, list virtualization, smooth 60fps animations, and avoiding overdraw or excessive re-renders.
3. State & Data Management: Local storage (SQLite, AsyncStorage, CoreData), state containers, and offline-first strategies.
4. Native Integrations: Push notifications, camera/sensors, permissions model, deep linking, and background task handling.

sections.heading: Question Strategy
lines: - Do not use a fixed sequence. Choose the next question based on the candidate's latest answer quality and identified gaps.
- Identify the candidate's primary platform (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter) early from their resume and focus accordingly.
- Use interview difficulty to calibrate: lifecycle basics for entry-level, memory management and concurrency trade-offs for senior.
- Use resume and job-description signals to focus on relevant APIs and store submission workflows.
- If no job description is provided, do not infer or fabricate JD-specific requirements.
- If the candidate is strong in one area, shift to another high-signal mobile competency to broaden assessment.
